decisions.rationale: All 212 comparators were reviewed. Blocked-episode identity, approval-card binding, action mapping, and decision authority are plausible neighbors, but none specifies the same Graph request-to-snapshot identity boundary and failure semantics.
All 212 comparators were reviewed. The neighboring GUI contracts govern accessibility or recovery behavior, not the classification metadata defect for the user-visible permission units.
